name: Unidentified IG-100 MagnaGuard (Green)
description: This MagnaGuard, alongside a gold counterpart, were present alongside a few other Separatist-aligned battle droids in the caves of Utapau. However, several of the droids ended up devoured by Nos monsters. The attack was also such that both IG-100 MagnaGuards were temporarily deactivated while subtly entering repair mode due to their containing a self-repair unit.
